_comment: Settings of the llama.cpp server (llama-server), the same on every machine. Values of this machine (installRoot, package, ...) are in config\machine.json, written by scripts\Install.ps1. Read by scripts\lib\Config.ps1. After a change run scripts\Restart-Server.ps1. Details: docs\backend.md.

packages._comment: What package 'auto' means (scripts\Install-LlamaCpp.ps1). With an NVIDIA card 'nvidia' is tried first; if llama.cpp then sees no card (driver too old for that CUDA version), 'nvidiaFallback'. 'other' for AMD and Intel cards (experimental, untested), 'cpu' without a usable card. The names are those of the files in a llama.cpp release: llama-<build>-bin-<package>.zip.

_sha256: SHA-256 of every file scripts\Install-LlamaCpp.ps1 may download, per build: nothing is installed without one, and GitHub must name the same (docs\backend.md). Taken from the release of ggml-org/llama.cpp when the build was chosen; the CUDA 13.5 files of b12433 also match the files that ran on the development computer. A new build needs its own entry.
_devices: The graphics cards llama.cpp may use, by their ids of 'llama-server --list-devices' (CUDA0, Vulkan1). Empty = every usable card. A machine chooses with /gpu in unzensiert (config\machine.json, section server); how much goes on which card the planner decides (docs\planner.md).
